new_candidates.body:
### Is there an already existing issue for this?

- [x] I have searched the existing issues

### Expected behavior

Commit 65010b234 ("Improve validation of EDP static properties") states in its code
comment that after the change "any other malformed input (consecutive dots,
leading/trailing dots, non-numeric characters...) is rejected instead of being silently
accepted".

Expected: an entity ID string containing an octet outside the 0-255 range, such as
`300.0.0.4`, `256.0.0.4`, or `-1.0.0.4`, is rejected the same way consecutive dots or
non-numeric characters are, since it cannot represent a valid `EntityId_t`.

### Current behavior

The four octets are parsed into `int` and then cast to `octet` with no range check, in
both property formats (legacy `eProsimaEDPStatic_*` and the `EDS_*` format added by
65010b234):

    src/cpp/rtps/builtin/discovery/endpoint/EDPStatic.cpp, EDPStaticProperty::fromProperty
    (~line 483 legacy branch, ~line 549 EDS_ branch):

    ss >> a >> ch >> b >> ch >> c >> ch >> d;
    bool success = !ss.fail() && ss.eof();
    if (success) { m_entityId.value[0] = (octet)a; ... }

Out-of-range values are silently truncated (mod 256) into a different, valid entity ID:

    "0.0.1.300"   -> accepted, becomes 0.0.1.44
    "0.0.1.-1"    -> accepted, becomes 0.0.1.255
    "0.0.1.256"   -> accepted, becomes 0.0.1.0
    "0.0.1.999999"-> accepted, becomes 0.0.1.63

No warning or log is emitted. The truncated ID is then used as-is by
EDPStatic::assignRemoteEndpoints / newRemoteReader to synthesize the remote endpoint, so
a peer announcing such a value gets paired under a different entity ID than the string
says — for a configuration typo this can silently pair the wrong endpoint or silently
fail to pair, with nothing to diagnose.

### Steps to reproduce

1. Parser level (same statement as fromProperty, deterministic):

       std::stringstream ss; ss << "300.0.0.4";
       int a, b, c, d; char ch;
       ss >> a >> ch >> b >> ch >> c >> ch >> d;
       bool success = !ss.fail() && ss.eof();   // true
       // (octet)a == 44

2. End-to-end (master, static EDP):
   - Participant created with use_SIMPLE_EndpointDiscoveryProtocol = false,
     use_STATIC_EndpointDiscoveryProtocol = true, exchange format v1, and a static XML
     declaring remote participant "attacker" reader userId=1, entityID=4, on the local
     writer's topic. A DataWriterListener prints the matched remote reader's entity ID.
   - Send one SPDP DATA(p) UDP packet to the discovery port carrying
     PID_PROPERTY_LIST (0x0059) with property
     `eProsimaEDPStatic_Reader_ALIVE_ID_1` = `300.0.0.4`.
   - Observed: publication matched, remote reader entity ID = 2c.00.00.04 (44), i.e.
     the out-of-range announcement was accepted and paired under the truncated ID.
   - Control 1: value `0.0.0.4` -> matched, entity ID 00.00.00.04.
   - Control 2: value `1.2.3.4.5` -> no match (correctly rejected, as intended by
     65010b234).

### Fast DDS version/commit

master @ 51521ef (2026-10-20). The unguarded (octet) cast predates the hardening, but
65010b234 (2026-09-10, currently master-only) is the commit whose comment claims
malformed input is rejected, so the gap is most visible there.
